publicationScope: generic US household two-line worked example; no user account details published
headline: The free phone isn't always the cheapest phone

device.taxRule: Sales tax on full or pre-credit purchase price can be charged at sale. Amount varies by jurisdiction and is omitted from modeled totals.

case.criteria: Generic public-price two-line scenarios with AutoPay where listed, no personal account data and no temporary codes. Taxes and unverified local fees excluded. The published offer-specific promotion caps are illustrative and require eligibility verification.

plans.name: Unlimited Starter × 2
plans.priorityNote: Priority and high-speed treatment depend on selected network; not suitable as a blanket guarantee of no deprioritization.
plans.limitations: 20GB hotspot per line. Check underlying network's premium-data priority and high-speed allowances.

plans.name: Unlimited Premium + Starter
plans.priorityNote: Premium's priority and network handling vary; Starter does not automatically inherit Premium priority.
plans.limitations: Different plans for the two people; full high-priority service not established on every network.

plans.name: Unlimited Premium × 2
plans.priorityNote: Carrier advertises unlimited priority data, with network-dependent policies and features.
plans.limitations: Confirm chosen underlying network and what priority means on that network.

plans.name: Visible+ × 2
plans.priorityNote: Premium data on Verizon's network subject to carrier broadband facts; no constant-speed guarantee.
plans.limitations: Hotspot speed cap and feature differences matter; regular $35/line, not the advertised temporary $30/line.

plans.name: Visible+ Pro × 2
plans.priorityNote: Premium data on Verizon's network, subject to network management; hotspot speed cap remains.
plans.limitations: Regular $45/line, excluding temporary promo; international and hotspot benefits may exceed Visible+.

plans.name: T-Mix More + 2 × $930 offers
plans.priorityNote: Qualifying plans promise premium network treatment subject to official policy; not identical to other carriers.
plans.limitations: Both promotions need individual eligibility and 2 Picks each; together use all 4 shared Picks. Two $1,200 promos do NOT fit. Includes stated regulatory/recovery fees, not taxes/surcharges.

plans.name: T-Mix More + 1 × $1,200 offer
plans.priorityNote: Same base service as above; one offer uses 3 of 4 account-shared Picks.
plans.limitations: Only one device is modeled with the $1,200 offer; second device is full price. A $1,200 + $930 combo needs 5 Picks and doesn't fit.

importantExclusions: Any existing loyalty credit, bundled home internet discount, or current installment agreement is account-specific; don't disclose private customer information or count a discount twice. Add verified changes to the household cost separately.
Existing installment balance and forfeited legacy promotion credits are excluded from generic totals; add when applicable, distinguishing accelerated principal from foregone credits.
Early device payoff can terminate future promotion credits while the remaining unpaid handset balance is still owed, depending on carrier and offer.
Carrier advertised device credit is a maximum; approval, port-in, new-line, trade-in, service selection, and 36-month good standing may be required.
Trade-in value must be handled consistently: compare a carrier's conditional trade-in credit with the actual resale/instant trade-in value forgone by handing over the phone.
The Apple device's satellite messaging capability is not an ordinary satellite voice or fully carrier-independent call guarantee.
Tax and federal/local surcharges where not included, activation costs beyond reported charges, insurance, accessories, financing opportunity cost and inflation are not quantified.
Temporary first-year pricing and annual prepaid plan discounts have not been blended into regular monthly prices; they require a separate time-varying ledger.
Cheaper regular-price plan is not necessarily equivalent in coverage, network priority, international service, customer support, hotspot or satellite access.

consumerPatterns.question: Does the plan cost more each month than buying a phone unlocked and using service with the features you need?
consumerPatterns.test: (carrier monthly service + required carrier recovery fees − comparison monthly service) × months; compare with credits actually earned

consumerPatterns.tag: A free phone with a 36-month string
consumerPatterns.question: How many credits would you lose if you left in month 12?
consumerPatterns.test: Unredeemed promotional credits = maximum eligible credits × remaining months ÷ total months, with eligibility and credit timing caveats

consumerPatterns.question: Can two family members claim simultaneous deals?
consumerPatterns.test: Total promotion Picks demanded ≤ account's available Picks; T-Mix More two lines: 4 Picks; two $1,200 offers need 6

consumerPatterns.question: Did the quote subtract a loyalty discount that was already part of the current bill?
consumerPatterns.test: Use actual NET baseline, not list price minus the already-applied credit again

consumerPatterns.question: Does moving phones increase home-internet price?
consumerPatterns.test: Household delta includes verified post-switch internet price minus present internet price

consumerPatterns.question: What happens to a financed phone and its trade-in promotion if you leave early?
consumerPatterns.test: Unpaid principal is distinct from the value of unearned credits and early payoff restrictions

sensitivity.note: Unknown values are displayed as exclusions, never silently assigned zero in the actual bill.
